**NORTHBANK COMMUNITY GARDEN**
**Notice to All Members and Visitors**

**North Gate Closure: Saturday 18 April**

Please note that the north gate will be closed on **Saturday 18 April from 9 am to 2 pm** while we repair a leaking water pipe. The leak has been wasting water and softening the path beside the herb beds, so we want to fix it quickly and properly.

**Please use the east entrance** during the closure. It will be open as usual, and signs will direct you from the street. Please take care on the temporary path, which may be uneven in places.

**Seed swap moved to Sunday**

Because of the repair work, this month's seed swap will now take place on **Sunday 19 April at 11 am**. Bring any spare seeds, cuttings, or seedlings to share, and feel free to bring labels and pens to help others identify what they take home.

**Volunteers needed**

We would be grateful for extra hands on Saturday to help clear the work area, move materials, and tidy up afterward. Please **bring gloves**; all tools will be supplied.

Our resident volunteer coordinator, **Mina**, will organize the helpers and assign tasks. Speak with her at the east entrance when you arrive.

Thank you for your patience and for helping keep Northbank thriving.

*The Northbank Garden Committee*
